result:
I found no blocking problems. The candidate meets A1 and A2 on my own runs. I'm reporting FINDINGS because of three advisory issues; the main one is a silent duplicate when an EmailMessage imported as a Task later has a recipient. A3 is the PL's live crm-dev run and I couldn't check it from here.

```
VERDICT: FINDINGS
CANDIDATE: 4a826e92a215cd23d8277afafaf342837dc9c2d0
FINDING task-then-email-duplicate advisory: an EmailMessage imported as a Task on an earlier run, whose To later validates, is also created as an Email, and the Task stays. One source row becomes two CRM records with no exception code. The WO only covers the opposite direction (an Email stays an Email). The Email branch in load/lib/crm_load/engine.py:580-593 does not check self.index["Task"]. | evidence: scratch probe aud/probe/test_probe.py (fixture org, run 1 with M[1] ToAddress=None, run 2 with the normal To) printed "run1 Task has M1: True Email has M1: False" / "run2 writes: [('POST', 'Email')]" / "run2 Task has M1: True Email has M1: True" / "codes M1: ['activity_parent_unresolved']" | expected: the CRM-008 "never moved" rule applied both ways. Either it stays a Task and updates as one, or the case gets a code. Never a silent second record. PL to decide whether this is in scope.
FINDING codes-on-refused-email-task advisory: when the email-as-Task record is refused (owner_required_unresolved), it still records email_without_recipient_imported_as_task and priority_server_default. That says it was imported and that a default was stored, but nothing was written (mapping.py:553-565 adds both codes before and regardless of the refusal). | evidence: A2 on the full selftest with 0 users provisioned: byReason email_without_recipient_imported_as_task=35, priority_server_default=35, EmailMessage skipped.owner_required_unresolved=35, targets={} | expected: these two codes only for records actually sent, so the counts are accurate (relevant to the 13 real messages that depend on CreatedById).
FINDING html-only-untested advisory: PL decision 3 (HTML-only body → null description) is implemented correctly but no test covers it. A mutation that sets the description to "x" when TextBody is blank survives the whole suite. | evidence: mutation `attrs["description"] = text(row.get("TextBody")) or "x"` → "Ran 178 tests … OK"; a direct mapper call with TextBody=None gives description=None, with no priority key | expected: one test that pins a null description for a TextBody-less message.
EVIDENCE:
- HEAD = 4a826e92a215cd23d8277afafaf342837dc9c2d0 (equals the candidate). One commit on top of 4bab43e. Changed files: docs/IMPORT.md, load/lib/crm_load/{api,engine,mapping}.py, tests/load/{fixtures,test_load}.py, all inside the allowlist. No new dependencies. Worktree status is unchanged before and after (only the ignored __pycache__ dirs that were already there).
- `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/unit` → 333 tests OK. `python3 -I -B -m unittest discover -s tests/load -t .` → 178 tests OK (PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1).
- Reference extractor copied to aud/, CONTRACT_VERSION 3→4. Full `selftest` → status=RECONCILED, checks=28, failed=0. The output was sealed as aud/a2-selftest (dirs 0700, files 0400) so the dev gate accepts it.
- A2 (aud/scripts/a2.py, test_load.FakeEspo with GBP as provisioned, all CRM-008-F checks on), run with 0 users and with all 6 users:
  - run-1 pass 1: rc=0, write_rejected=0 (6 users: 284 writes, including 64 POST Task with 35 email-Tasks and 4 owner_from_created_by).
  - run-1 pass 2: rc=0, writes=0, 60 single-record GETs, reads=78.
  - run-2 snapshot: 1 write (PUT Contact title, the update scenario), then a second pass with writes=0.
  - No DELETE requests. Only GET, POST and PUT were used.
  - "SENTINEL" does not appear in exceptions.jsonl, stderr or the report.
- Ignore my first A2 attempt: it used the bare fixtures.FakeEspo (USD only) and got 50 Opportunity `validCurrency` refusals. That was my setup mistake, not the candidate.
- Mutations (scratch copy, git archive HEAD):
  - Killed: phone-always-write, phone-no-read, phone-no-primary-check, phone-src-no-trim, list-phoneNumber, single-read-not-counted, fake-phone-list, title-sent, title-nocode, fake-title, dc-always, dc-nocode, fake-dc, email-no-task, email-existing-to, email-existing-moved, fake-email-to, owner-no-createdby, owner-createdby-first, priority-sent, flag-task.
  - Survived: task-desc-html (finding above), and phone-no-trim on the listed phoneNumber only (harmless, because the stored primary is already trimmed).
- Code review:
  - The new EspoClient.get is GET-only and counts in reads; a refused read raises read_failed (exit 4, tested).
  - The owner order is linked Task → provisioned CreatedById (owner_from_created_by) → refused (owner_required_unresolved), with no placeholder.
  - priority is not sent. description comes from TextBody only. HtmlBody is never read.
  - Exception lines carry only object, sfId and reason.
  - No earlier rule is weakened: the email_from_invalid and owner refusals still apply on the Email path.
```
